title: iOS14 Catches Apps Spying on Your Clipboard
summary: A one-minute demonstration of iOS 14's new paste notification, which revealed popular apps silently reading the clipboard each time they were opened. It credits the mysk research write-up.
why: HN cites it as evidence that many mainstream apps, not just TikTok, were snooping on clipboard contents.

quote.text: Here's a rundown of just general apps that would be on everyone's home screens doing the same thing.
